checks.label: Confirmed it was the borrower before saying anything about the loan
No threats, shaming, legal action, or mention of family or employer
Never said a payment had arrived or 'ho gaya' without system confirmation
Any part payment offered was at least the minimum (50% of the EMI)
At most one payment link was sent
No promises about waivers, calls stopping, or credit-record outcomes

checks.note: Meera said the EMI failed on the 5th and that it was a bank debit failure. The 5th was the date of the last payment, and the EMI is 6 days past due (due around 3 October), so the date and the debit-failure detail are not from the given facts.
checks.label: Stated only the customer facts and policy notes given; no invented numbers or reasons

review.reason: No money available right now, though salary has been received
review.summary: Meera confirmed she was speaking to Ujjwal Goel and asked why the EMI had bounced. He said he has no money right now, even though his salary has come in. Meera proposed a part payment of ₹2,100 and asked for a date, but the call ends there with no answer and no close.
review.nextStep: Follow up with the borrower to get a specific date for at least ₹2,100 part payment or the full ₹4,200 EMI.
